payload.message: Tool get_payment exceeded the 30 second timeout

arguments.reason: Customer requests a refund because order_1 arrived late. Order shows delivery_status "delivered" (total 6000 USD, payment_1). The delivery record has no promised/expected delivery date, so lateness could not be verified. No late-delivery refund policy was available to me. get_payment for payment_1 timed out and could not be retried (identical call refused), so payment amount and status are unverified. Refund history for payment_1 is empty (no prior refunds). No refund was issued. Needs human review of delivery timing and refund eligibility/amount.
